label: KT route frame entails the T schema of the route's NECESSARY_2 box
meaning: If the route's modal frame is reflexive (KT), the T schema 'necessarily p implies p' of the route's box is valid on it, for every valuation of its atom and every world. Applies the existing modal-library theorem TruthCore.Modal.axiomT_valid to the route frame. Establishes neither premise; with the converse result it shows that the KT frame premise and the T schema premise are equivalent.
